description: manni docs meta/index, the 30-second proof, run on a document that is missing the required type.

steps.description: Run it: the file is missing a required field, and the result names the field and the schema.

runShell.stdio: /✗ path\/to\/your-doc\.md[\s\S]*\(root\)  must have required property 'type'[\s\S]*\[google:okf:0\.1\][\s\S]*1 file checked, 0 passed, 1 failed, 1 error/

steps.description: Fix the field: add type to the frontmatter.
Run it again: a file with complete, well-formed metadata passes.

runShell.stdio: /✓ path\/to\/your-doc\.md[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors/
